title: Trashventory
description: A server-side /trash bin: dumped items delete after a configurable delay (with a grab-back window). Works for vanilla clients. The optional client mod adds an inventory icon, a smooth settings GUI, a personal timer, and an auto-delete blacklist.
body:
# Trashventory

A personal `/trash` bin for your Fabric server. Drop items you do not want, close it, and after a short delay they are deleted forever - with a grab-back window if you change your mind.

The whole `/trash` feature is **server-side**, so it works for players on **vanilla (unmodded) clients**. Installing the mod on the client adds extras.

## Features
- `/trash` (alias `/tr`) opens your private bin - a normal chest GUI.
- Items left inside are deleted after a configurable delay; reopen before it ends to take them back (the countdown pauses while open).
- Survives relogs and restarts: the countdown freezes while you are offline.
- **Client extras (optional):** a one-click inventory trash icon, a settings gear on the bin, a smooth flat settings GUI (also via ModMenu), a personal shorter-only timer, and an **auto-delete blacklist** (items vanish the instant they enter your inventory).

## Player commands
- `/trash` (or `/tr`) - open the bin
- `/trash timer default|off|<seconds>`
- `/trash message on|off`
- `/trash blacklist add|remove|list|clear`
- `/trash settings`

## Admin commands (OP only)
- `/trash admin size single|double`
- `/trash admin timer <seconds>|off`
- `/trash admin message on|off`
- `/trash admin clientoverride on|off`
- `/trash admin clear <player>`
- `/trash admin reload`

## Requirements
Minecraft **26.1.2**, Fabric Loader **0.19.2+**, **Fabric API**. ModMenu optional.
